evidence.why: Shows both getter signatures, indexed dereferences, 25-entry accumulation, and the ineffective unsigned clamp comparison.
The distance accessor returns an indexed persistent fighter field.
Home-Run uses the HUD index, localized distance conversion, and the aggregate divided by 100 or 30.4788.
Existing Highscore/TotalHighscore pairs support the proposed naming convention.

reason: The individual getter forwards its byte index and returns the persistent distance as u32; the total reads the same field for 25 indices. The Home-Run display consumes both and shows the total with metric/feet conversions. Names are retained only as descriptive reconstructions. References to a clamp branch are valid syntactically, not as a claim of effective saturation: tmp is already u32 when compared with UINT_MAX.

evidence.why: Contains the complete guarded, read-only query.

reason: Canonical bodies confirm the signatures, completion guards, nullable output stores, frame decomposition, and all-25 aggregation gate. Result processing establishes the transition from count to completion frames and subsequent lower-time improvements. The inferred names remain reasonable semantic hypotheses, not recovered historical symbols.
